text.title: 野外笔记本上的名称
text.situation:
回到室外桌旁，露丝打开野外笔记。一栏记录当地植物群，另一栏记录动物群。玛雅拍了门边花卉展，而动物照片应放进动物记录。页面里有多种生物，但露丝核对同一物种的重复观察没有被当作新种类。它们的多样性属于这里的生物多样性。笔记旁示意图把生物与土、水和空气相连，展示生态系统。

乔：多样性只是动物数量大吗？
露丝：不是，指不同种类。我们还看生态系统里的关系。
玛雅：能说笔记列出了这里所有生命吗？
露丝：只能说记录了截至目前观察到的对象。

paragraphs.en: Back at the outdoor desk, Ruth opened a field notebook. One section recorded the local flora, another the fauna. Maya had photographed a floral display near the doorway; the animal photographs belonged in the faunal record instead. The pages showed diverse living things, but Ruth checked that repeated sightings of the same species were not counted as new kinds. Their variety was part of the site’s biodiversity. Beside the notebook, a diagram connected living things with soil, water and air to show an ecosystem.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Does diversity just mean a large number of animals?
Ruth: No. It refers to different kinds. We also look at the relationships in the ecosystem.
Maya: Can I call the notebook a list of everything that lives here?
Ruth: Only a record of what has been observed so far.

S15.G09.P01.cue: 说明笔记的两个主栏目。
acceptableAnswers: 一个记录植物群，另一个记录动物群。

S15.G09.P03.cue: 解释不同种类与重复观察的区别。
acceptableAnswers: 生态系统中的多种物种带来多样性和生物多样性。

S15.G09.T01.cue: 描述城市花园的不同植物种类。
acceptableAnswers: 花园有多种多样的植物。
